### Kingdom Advancement - Powerpoint - March 21, 2013
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-march-21-2013.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 1:10
Points:
- Churches often allow minor, insignificant matters to cause deep division.
- A ripe harvest field illustrates how high grain hides divisive boundary fences.
- Keeping our focus on evangelism causes secondary disputes to fade into the background.
- Fulfilling the Great Commission requires believers to lay aside petty differences.
- When the church works together in unity, the world clearly sees God's grace.

### The Main Thing - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-main-thing-one-year-devotions-for-men-april-13.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 1:10
Points:
- A loss of focus combined with internal conflict will ruin any organization.
- Despite abundant spiritual gifts and advantages, the Corinthian church faltered through strife.
- Believers fell into partisan factions based on their preferred Christian leaders.
- Squabbling over personalities wasted spiritual energy and ruined their Christian witness.
- Church unity requires keeping the gospel and the cross of Christ central.
